headline: Keeping care local
local_services: CT, ultrasound, mammography, lab, physical therapy and colonoscopy
op_move_title: Keep ordered imaging, lab, therapy and GI work local
access_note: Booking is by phone only, and the clinic phones close at 4:30 p.m.
plan_note: The board's plan already names patient access as a priority; moves 1 to 3 fit under it.
front_door: The website lists services but not their hours or how to book them. Imaging and lab have no page of their own.
Booking is by phone only, weekdays until 4:30 p.m. There is no online scheduling and no text reminders.
The swing-bed page describes the program but gives referring hospitals no direct contact.
community: Residents name travel distance, after-hours care and specialist access as the top barriers.
The strategic plan commits to better patient access and a larger swing-bed program.
